versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Enterprise AI Security Controls Assessment skill.
- Provides comprehensive AI security posture assessments across 14 enterprise security domains, including identity, data protection, prompt injection defense, and compliance mapping.
- Supports detailed evaluation against multiple security frameworks with actionable findings and remediation recommendations.
- Includes endpoints for full security assessment, health checks, and domain metadata retrieval.
- Designed for CISOs, security teams, and AI governance to identify gaps, manage risk, and demonstrate compliance at enterprise scale.
